about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Aspiring Full Stack Developer & Year 2 MIS Student
about.description: I am a motivated Year 2, Semester 2 student majoring in Management Information Systems (MIS) at SETEC Institute with an outstanding GPA of 3.95/4.0. My background includes a national High School BACII Grade B, 6 months of frontend teamwork training at Simpaz Center, and an intensive Full Stack Web Development bootcamp at TFD. I build responsive, end-to-end applications using Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, with a focus on RESTful APIs, JWT security, and CI/CD best practices.
about.comp_frontend_desc: Building responsive, modern UIs with Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Angular, React, and TypeScript.
about.comp_backend_desc: Architecting RESTful APIs with Node.js, Express, MongoDB & Mongoose, MySQL, and JWT authentication.
about.comp_uiux_desc: Designing clean prototypes, wireframes, and user flows in Figma learned through my MIS UI/UX course.
about.comp_perf_desc: Docker containerization, Postman API testing, Git & GitHub workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
